comments.body:
Should the `System Info` capture the OS version?

```
$ lsb_release -a
No LSB modules are available.
Distributor ID:	Ubuntu
Description:	Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS
Release:	22.04
Codename:	jammy
```
On Linux we use `xdg-open` with a `vscode:/` URI to activate VS Code. Please ensure that is working correctly to activate the application.

Running

```
xdg-open "vscode://file/home/hamir/.bashrc"
```

from my terminal seems to work. It opens up `.bashrc` in VSCode.

```
$  xdg-mime query default x-scheme-handler/vscode
code_code-url-handler.desktop
```

Is this problematic?

```
$  ls ~/.local/share/applications/code-url-handler.desktop
ls: cannot access '/home/hamir/.local/share/applications/code-url-handler.desktop': No such file or directory
```

>Is this problematic?

I'm guessing that's likely the issue, yep

This issue has been closed as it has been labeled with `info-needed` and has not received the additional information that was requested from the issue author. It has been labeled as `info-needed` for 7 days.
